exposure: prenatal pesticide exposure (chlorpyrifos, insecticide, fungicide, herbicide, molluscicide, glyphosate, paraquat, butachlor, methyl parathion, savin, methomyl, endosulfan, carbosulfan, methamidophos, monochrotofos, mancozeb, bordeaumixture)
cohort: The study included 442 children with suspected developmental delay and 413 controls with normal development, all aged under 5 years and matched for gender, age, and residency.
finding: Chlorpyrifos exposure during pregnancy and postnatally significantly increased the risk of developmental delay in children aged under 5 years, with some other pesticides also showing positive but not statistically significant associations.
